latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Recovery Day Planner

- Provides a planning framework for recovery days after physical exertion, travel, or minor illness
- Includes prompts for rest, hydration, nutrition, and light movement
- Offers scenario-based templates and planning questions
- Lists red flags and clear boundaries for when to seek medical guidance
- Emphasizes non-medical use; does not replace professional advice or care
